devices.detail.binding.label: Fixed agent binding
devices.detail.loadFailedDesc: Try again. If it keeps failing, check the device gateway.
devices.detail.notFound.desc: It may have been deleted, or it left the workspace it was opened from.
devices.detail.notFound.title: Device not found
devices.detail.sharedFromHint: Shared from a personal device into this workspace.
devices.detail.title: Device details
devices.empty.description: Try another keyword or clear the filters.
devices.empty.title: No devices match these filters
devices.error.generic: Could not load the device list. Try again.
devices.online.unknownHint: Presence could not be confirmed: the device gateway is not configured or the check timed out. This is not the same as offline.

labs.desc: One switch for the whole deployment. In administrator mode every user sees only the experiments turned on here; the list follows the upstream Labs page, so new experiments appear automatically.
labs.error.conflictContent: Another administrator saved the Labs settings first. Refresh to load the latest version.
labs.error.invalidLabsConfig: One of the flags is not recognized. Refresh the page and try again.
labs.error.loadFailed: Could not load the Labs settings
labs.extra.desc: These switches have no entry on the upstream Labs page, so they are listed apart from the experiment matrix. In administrator mode they still apply deployment-wide.
labs.extra.title: Internal switches
labs.flags.desc: Read-only entries are also gated by a deployment setting, so this switch alone does not enable them.
labs.flags.title: Experiments
labs.mode.adminDesc: Replace every user's Labs preferences with the flags below. An experiment that is not turned on here stays off; user preferences are ignored, and the per-user Labs page is hidden from non-administrators.
labs.mode.confirmToAdminContent: Each user currently decides for themselves. In administrator control the switches below decide for everyone: experiments that are not turned on stop working for every non-administrator after you save, and the per-user Labs settings page is hidden from them. Saving applies this immediately to everyone.
labs.mode.confirmToUserContent: The deployment-wide switches stop applying, every user goes back to their own Labs preferences, and the per-user Labs settings page becomes visible again after you save.
labs.mode.confirmToUserTitle: Hand Labs back to each user?
labs.mode.desc: Who decides which experiments run on this deployment.
labs.mode.title: Control mode
labs.mode.userDesc: Keep the upstream behaviour: everyone picks Labs experiments in their own settings.
labs.note.businessUnavailable: Unavailable on this deployment: it needs the business feature service.
labs.note.modePending: The mode changes only after you save.
labs.note.noSettingsEntry: This experiment has no entry on the Labs settings page upstream; it can only be set here.
labs.note.pageCollabDeployment: Live collaboration also needs a deployment gateway (ENABLE_PAGE_COLLAB) and workspace access; this switch alone does not turn it on.
labs.note.unsetOff: In administrator control an experiment that is not turned on here is off for every non-administrator; it never falls back to a personal preference.
labs.note.userMode: Switch to administrator mode to edit the experiments.
labs.title: Labs
modelService.action.reset: Reverted to the last saved state.
modelService.action.saved: Saved the endpoint, key and defaults; no user settings were changed.
modelService.catalog.empty: The catalog is empty. Fetch from the service or add a model manually.
modelService.catalog.hint: "Open" only controls whether the model appears in the user model list; it writes no user data.
modelService.catalog.title: Model catalog
modelService.connection.apiKeyDesc: Generate the key in the Tellhow gateway and paste it here; it takes effect with Save. The full key is never shown again.
modelService.connection.baseURLDesc: Users cannot see or change it. A saved address takes effect on the next request.
modelService.connection.desc: The company owns the endpoint and key; they stay on the server. Users only pick models.
modelService.connection.enabledDesc: When off, Tellhow disappears from the user side; the saved endpoint and key are kept.
modelService.connection.keyNotSet: No key saved yet. Paste one and save.
modelService.connection.testDesc: Requests /models once with the saved endpoint and key, and only reports status, latency and model count.
modelService.connection.testNeedsConfig: Save the endpoint and access key first
modelService.connection.title: Service connection
modelService.defaults.chat: Default chat model for new users
modelService.defaults.chatDesc: Preselected on the first conversation; never written into user settings.
modelService.defaults.desc: Optional. Affects new users and system tasks only; users can change everything.
modelService.defaults.embeddingDesc: Used for memory and knowledge retrieval. Changing it invalidates stored vectors; reindex afterwards.
modelService.defaults.title: Title generation / history compression
modelService.defaults.titleDesc: A lightweight model for background tasks.
modelService.defaults.verifyDesc: The model used for verification tasks.
modelService.edit.added: Model added; it stays closed to users
modelService.edit.duplicateId: This model ID is already in the catalog
modelService.edit.name: Display name
modelService.edit.namePlaceholder: The name users see in the list
modelService.edit.openDesc: Only affects user-side visibility; writes nothing into user settings.
modelService.edit.removeContent: Removes "{{name}}" from the catalog so users no longer see it. Existing user settings stay untouched.
modelService.edit.removeTitle: Remove this model from the catalog?
modelService.error.conflictContent: Another admin just saved the model service configuration. Refresh to see the latest version, then review and save again.
modelService.error.invalidApiKey: The access key needs at least 8 characters and is stored only on the server.
modelService.error.invalidBaseUrl: The endpoint must be an http(s) URL and cannot contain credentials.
modelService.error.invalidDefaultModel: A default must point at a model in the current catalog.
modelService.error.invalidModel: The model metadata is incomplete or malformed.
modelService.error.loadFailed: Could not load the model service configuration
modelService.error.notConfigured: Save the service endpoint and access key before enabling the model service.
modelService.footer: Users only see models marked "Open to everyone". Closing a model hides it from the user model list and does not touch user data.
modelService.note: Saving only updates this global configuration and writes nothing into any user setting; the endpoint and key never reach the browser.
modelService.subtitle: The company maintains the Tellhow endpoint and key in one place. Users see a built-in provider, pick models, and never fill in a key.
modelService.sync.applyHint: New models arrive closed to users and marked "Needs review"; models gone upstream are marked, never deleted.
modelService.sync.desc: Upstream returned {{count}} models. Review the diff against the local catalog; nothing is written until you apply.
modelService.sync.needsConfig: Save the service endpoint and access key first.
modelService.sync.needsReview: {{count}} models had their type inferred from the name. Confirm them under Edit after applying.
modelService.sync.noChanges: The local catalog matches upstream; there is nothing to apply.
modelService.sync.title: Fetch model catalog
modelService.title: Model service
